description: Ministry of Health & Nutrition Indigenous Medicine -  The Food (Preservatives) Regulations 2019
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980. It establishes new legal requirements for food preservatives, including permitted substances, usage proportions, labeling requirements, and standards of purity. The content focuses entirely on creating a new regulatory framework and legal compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing legal regulations rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities.
